players.injury_comment: Thompson (ankle) did not participate in Sunday morning's shootaround, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.
Murray is questionable to play Sunday against the Grizzlies due to left ankle capsulitis.
Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.
Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.
